chunks: When his Lord called to him in the holy valley of Tuwa.
ai.seo_question: Where did God call Prophet Musa according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'holy valley of Tuwa' is often interpreted not merely as a geographical site but as a spiritual station of divine proximity, emphasizing the unique status of Musa (AS) as a Kalimullah (one who spoke directly to God). This verse underscores the sanctity of the location where the prophetic mission was initiated, linking the physical landscape to the metaphysical reality of divine revelation and the purification of the prophet's heart.
